Name: Elliott Rewritten
Author: writertron
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod will provide a complete overhaul for Elliott's character while still maintaining the style and tone of 'Stardew Valley'. This mod is still in its alpha stages, it contains a major rewrite of Elliott's dialogue as well as two custom heart events; a two-heart and three-heart event.[/color]

Here's how these heart events are triggered:
2-heart event - Enter the beach between 3pm and 6pm.
3-heart event - Enter the saloon between 8pm and 10pm.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Content Patcher.
3. Unzip this mod.
4. Place both included folders into Stardew Valley/Mods.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod is currently in alpha. Elliott’s early heart events and dialogue are being rewritten first, with more events and polish planned for future updates.[/color]
